OAuthLoginClientID.description: OAuth2 client identifier issued by the provider.

OAuthLoginClientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret issued by the provider.

OAuthLoginUserInfoURL.description: Provider userinfo endpoint URL returning JSON.

OAuthLoginRedirectURI.description: Absolute callback URL. Must be the full URL of Special:OAuthLogin on this wiki.

OAuthLoginAutoCreate.description: Create local user accounts automatically for provider identities not yet bound to a local account.

OAuthLoginLinkByEmail.description: Bind a provider identity to an existing local account when the provider reports a verified email that exactly matches that account's confirmed email. Off by default; enable only if you trust the provider's email verification.

OAuthLoginAllowedDomains.description: Optional list of email domains allowed to authenticate. When set, the provider must report a verified email on one of these domains.

OAuthLoginRememberMe.description: Issue a long-lived session cookie after OAuth login.
